page: Amazon Web Services im4gn.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by an 8-core custom 64-bit ARM processor based on the AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture. Running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, the instance delivers dedicated CPU performance without multithreading across its 8 physical cores. It features 32 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, alongside a total of 3,750 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. Network throughput is capped at a baseline rate of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the im4gn.2xlarge demonstrates steady multi-core execution and reliable database performance. Tests show average output in multi-threaded execution, Redis key-value operations at 9.97 million operations per second, static web serving throughput, and software compilation tasks. Memory bandwidth is measured at 121.23 GB/sec for uncached reads and 54.16 GB/sec for uncached writes. However, single-core processing capabilities and specialized execution instructions produce lower relative scores, as observed in single-threaded compression benchmarks and synthetic single-core tests.

By pairing energy-efficient ARM architecture with substantial local NVMe SSD storage density, the instance offers strong cost efficiency for I/O-intensive workloads requiring localized persistent cache or fast temporary storage. The hardware composition provides a balanced ratio of compute and memory alongside low-latency disk throughput, making it well-suited for database engines, cache layers, log analytics, data pipeline processing, and distributed key-value storage deployments.
description: Amazon Web Services im4gn.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance built on an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 ARM processor running at 2.5 GHz on the Nitro hypervisor. It is equipped with 32 GB of RAM and 3,750 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage, supported by a 12 Gbps baseline network capacity. Benchmark results show average multi-core CPU capacity, strong web serving throughput, and solid performance in key-value database execution, such as reaching 9.97 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-core performance and specialized compression tasks show lower comparative benchmark throughput. With its high disk capacity to vCPU ratio and ARM-based resource density, the im4gn.2xlarge offers qualitative cost advantages for localized storage workloads. The server is suited for database hosting, log analytics, cache clusters, and general data-processing pipelines.
